text: 同事改了共用稿，文件日期和字节数看起来都没变化，怎样确定我手里的编辑稿还能直接保存？

外部改稿: 即使文件大小和修改时间都相同，只要内容指纹变了，普通保存就会停下来并提示冲突。
concurrent-memo: Compare the persisted bytes against the fingerprint captured at open; a mismatch blocks an ordinary save.

text: 正文里搜两个汉字时，三元组索引找不到，通配符又要按原字面匹配，有什么兜底？

标签关键词: 三元组全文索引无法匹配只有两个字符的子串查询，此时正文搜索回退到转义后的 LIKE。
标签结果保持按修改时间倒序，用户输入的百分号和下划线按字面比较。
small-cjk-token: With a trigram index, route one- and two-character substring terms to an escaped LIKE predicate.

text: 不同文件夹都有相同标题，没写路径的内部引用会先找哪一篇？

文件夹同名: 对于仅写了文件名的链接，解析器先尝试引用者所在目录里的同名笔记。
atlas-links: For an unqualified name shared by several notes, resolve to the sibling of the referring note when available.

text: 给展示公式的空行插入隐形字符，怎么防止后面的待办勾选写错字？

复选框偏移: 公式预处理只能用等长替换，避免后续任务框写回源文档时定位偏移。
anex-render-tree: The math preprocessor must preserve string length because every interactive checkbox uses an offset into the original Markdown.

text: 一直敲字从来没有停顿，自动落盘的静置计时器推后了很久，怎样保证过一段时间会保存一次？

收班前备份: 连续输入时设置一次最长等待期限，让保存任务即使始终收不到安静窗口也会落盘。
draft-cadence: After the maximum dirty interval expires, persist the draft even when typing has never become idle.

text: 标本柜那种带绿色线的湿度卡，哪些小珠变粉红就该换干燥袋？

east-wing-lab: 参考线旁的珠子全部变成粉红色就更换干燥包，再把更换时刻记在柜门卡片背面。
salt-card: Replace the desiccant pack once all indicator beads next to the green stripe have turned pink.

text: 夜间补回昨日测到的雨量，日报按机房日期算还是测点所在地当天算？

河岸浮标: 雨量日报按测点所在时区的自然日归档，跨午夜补发的旧测量仍归到它实际发生的那一天。

text: 移动盘扫完根目录就断开，没扫到的笔记记录可以删了吗？

目录普查: 只有完整遍历全部子目录，索引器才有依据移除本次扫描未见到的记录。
stale-shelf: An interrupted walk keeps existing rows for paths it did not manage to visit.
remote-walk: Keep cached entries on any partial directory traversal and prune them only after a complete census.
catalog-commit: deletion candidates are actionable only after all directories have been enumerated.

text: An older folder walk finishes after an editor publishes a new title. What should prevent its rows from replacing the edit?

stale-shelf: At publication, a refresh may replace search rows only if its starting generation still matches the shelf's current generation.
catalog-commit: The catalog writer compares a revision counter under the commit lock and discards any scan built from a superseded snapshot.
目录普查: 扫描开始时记录索引代数；提交前再次对比，避免用早先读到的摘要覆盖用户刚保存的新摘要。

text: If I pull from the screen edge and change my mind partway through, how should the open reader and its scroll position behave?

android-back-gesture: The host now keeps its original entry throughout the drag and resets the animation when the drag is abandoned.
Only the committed gesture removes the destination from the navigation stack.
手势回退: 拖到一半反悔时保留当前目的地与阅读状态，系统确认完成以后才出栈。

text: Which part of a note reference should move with the file, and what happens to the section and link caption?

atlas-links: When updating incoming links after a move, change the destination path while preserving the fragment and the display label.
文件夹同名: 批量改目录时仅更新链接目标的路径部分，章节后缀和别名继续沿用。

text: Can the ferry gate approve a passenger using an out-of-date passenger list while its network is down?

ferry-board: The ticket gate refuses to confirm boarding offline when the passenger manifest has expired, even if yesterday's departure board still opens.
渡口检票: 当缓存的乘船名册超过有效期时，离线闸机拒绝确认上船。

text: Why is adding 24 hours to the previous start unreliable for a daily rain report at a clock change?

ledger-date-boundary: Derive both endpoints from successive local midnights because a station day can last 23 or 25 hours.

text: The thumbnail's animation is disabled in system settings. Does selecting it still finish opening the note route?

motion-pref: When system animation duration is zero, switch directly to the final layout while completing the navigation state transition.
低动态模式: 系统动画时长为零时直接展示目标布局，路由状态照常完成切换。

text: If the user chooses to force their version into a shared draft, what must succeed before the saved version is replaced?

concurrent-memo: The explicit replace action first writes a recoverable copy of the previous disk contents and stops if that copy cannot be created.
外部改稿: 明确覆盖以前要先成功归档磁盘上的旧稿；归档失败就保持原件和草稿。

text: How can an attachment retry avoid creating a second copy when the server processed the first request but the client never got a reply?

upload-burst: Reuse the same idempotency key on each retry so the service returns the outcome of the original attachment upload.
挂起上传: 同一份附件的每次补传都使用最初生成的幂等键，避免重试创建重复对象。

text: 编辑器退到 background 时还有 dirty buffer，怎么把最后一段送去落盘？

收班前备份: 界面退到后台时立即请求提交编辑缓冲区，带着尚未写入的最后一段文字。
draft-cadence: When the editor loses foreground, flush the still-dirty buffer immediately instead of waiting for the idle timer.

text: 遇到同名 `wiki link`，只填 filename 的情况下怎样优先选当前目录的讲义？

文件夹同名: 对于仅写了文件名的链接，解析器先尝试引用者所在目录里的同名笔记。
atlas-links: For an unqualified name shared by several notes, resolve to the sibling of the referring note when available.

catalog-commit: deletion candidates are actionable only after all directories have been enumerated.

text: 截屏做 predictive back 验收时，drag 进行了一半又取消了，页面 entry 什么时候才该移除？

android-back-gesture: Only the committed gesture removes the destination from the navigation stack.
手势回退: 拖到一半反悔时保留当前目的地与阅读状态，系统确认完成以后才出栈。

text: 文件挪目录后的 `link rewrite` 应该保留 fragment 和 display label 吗？

atlas-links: When updating incoming links after a move, change the destination path while preserving the fragment and the display label.
文件夹同名: 批量改目录时仅更新链接目标的路径部分，章节后缀和别名继续沿用。

text: CJK 两字 substring 走 FTS trigram 不命中，回退查询应怎样看待 underscore？

标签关键词: 三元组全文索引无法匹配只有两个字符的子串查询，此时正文搜索回退到转义后的 LIKE。
标签结果保持按修改时间倒序，用户输入的百分号和下划线按字面比较。

text: 一个现场 transport retry 怎么复用 attachment 的 request identity，避免创建两份对象？

upload-burst: Reuse the same idempotency key on each retry so the service returns the outcome of the original attachment upload.
挂起上传: 同一份附件的每次补传都使用最初生成的幂等键，避免重试创建重复对象。

text: 雨量日统计遇到夏令时切换，为什么不能直接拿昨天的起点加固定一昼夜？

ledger-date-boundary: Derive both endpoints from successive local midnights because a station day can last 23 or 25 hours.

text: 平板旋转后图片才下载完，怎样记住读到的那一段，而不受页面高度后来变化影响？

image-height: Restore the paragraph key and the displacement within it after a rotation; a raw pixel offset drifts when illustrations load.

text: 雾天渡口改到对岸后，已经签到的乘客订单怎样转到替代船班？

ferry-board: During a diversion, orders already checked in can be moved to the replacement sailing through reconciliation.

text: 修一台桌面风扇换轴承，旧的薄垫圈应放到新零件的什么位置？

repair-list: When the old bearing is removed, keep its shim and install it against the new bearing's inner race.

text: For a large file transfer that stopped midway, what boundary should the next request start from when the UI had overreported progress?

附件分片: 续传从服务端确认的最后一个完整分片之后开始，舍弃本地提前显示的进度。

text: If a paragraph splits across two PDF pages, which line should the sidebar jump to?

段尾锚点: 当导出器在页面底部拆开一个段落时，侧栏仍跳到这个段落的第一行。

text: On a keyboard-only grid, how can focus return to the selected card after the sort order changed while its detail pane was open?

边栏回放: 若条目的排序位置已改变，按该条目的稳定标识恢复键盘焦点。

text: When a dispatch ticket gets authorized by someone working offline, is the device clock or the server's signed receipt used for posting schedule switches?

进度冲账: 调班审批以服务端收到签名的顺序落账，离线终端的本地时间只用于显示。
